independent_tests.warnings: One existing Torch JIT deprecation warning

resolved_findings: The benchmark retains and rechecks the final diagnostic helper source hash used by the new 512-step timing modes.

Diagnostic timing records a synchronized whole-helper call duration including parity, warmup and audits for both clean and common-state modes, and records numeric artifact publication time separately.
The saved random-seed description now distinguishes autonomous rollout, common-state SeedSequence material, and clean zero-noise validation.
reviewed_contracts: The first five policies delegate to the pinned native module unchanged. The sixth computes float64 incoming-native-nonself relative-velocity RMS with explicit native-order accumulation, then selects an exact annulus budget and appends both directed orientations after the unchanged capped native prefix.
No target enters graph selection. Same-state comparisons use a fixed observed history and separately charged previous-observed native-base scoring; autonomous cached-risk semantics remain separate.

The new graph-support checkpoint schema excludes the old full-training, old CUDA and continuation schemas. Timing execution accepts only root-released 512-update checkpoints; final execution requires a complete six-model 100000-update cohort and a hash-bound root audit of all model endpoints, optimizer states and paired initialization/schedules.

The final cohort gate executes before reading the evaluation manifest. The selected checkpoint bytes and payload are checked against the frozen graph-support architecture, detached faithful objective, graph exposure, cadence, source/data/protocol and deterministic runtime provenance.

Final common-state scheduling remains all30 trajectories x5 fixed frames per split. All six policy methods plus natural-base reference receive seven balanced timing rotations; the declared 124704 forward-call cohort includes clean validation.
The 512-step diagnostic timer uses exactly three source-size cases x5 fixed frames, validation only; it calls the same pinned final numerical helpers and does not promote timing results.
Failure evidence is retained, incomplete policy coverage yields null complete-cohort metrics, and implementation/native-parity failures halt subsequent inference.

Removing the duplicate final checkpoint load is sound: prepare_model and check_checkpoint_contract already enforce the exact100000 endpoint, cadence, training protocol, graph ledger and deterministic provenance before returning the checked model identity.
remaining_limits: Root must audit all six actual final checkpoint bytes, Adam states, initialization tensors/RNG and complete paired schedules before issuing the final cohort manifest. This review does not perform that audit.
The 512-update checkpoints and their timings are infrastructure evidence only. Full scientific results require the complete prospectively fixed cohort and evaluation workload.
The tests use synthetic arrays, tiny models or mocks only; no real Sand data, full model, CUDA process, remote host or test source was accessed.
